journey.name: Settings opened from v2 leads back to v2
journey.description: Start: the Mailflare v2 inbox is open and signed in. Settings are a classic page with the classic drawer; opened from v2, its mail links must lead back to v2, not to the classic pages.

actions.action: Tap the menu button at the top left of the screen and tap "Settings" in the drawer
Verify that settings sections are shown as a horizontal row of tabs at the top (including "Account")
Tap the menu button at the top left of the screen and tap "Inbox" in the drawer
Verify that the v2 inbox is shown with the "Search mail" field and the round compose button
Tap the menu button at the top left of the screen and tap "Settings" in the drawer
Tap the menu button at the top left of the screen and tap "Archived" in the drawer
Verify that the v2 list heading reads "Archive"
